lens: wahdat al-wujud; unity of being through divine names

where: Deliverance from Error / Revival of the Religious Sciences
lens: the disenchantment that begins true certainty
the seekers discover they are the sought
intoxication as theology; the wine-house as mosque
sobriety after annihilation; fana then baqa
light as ontology; degrees of luminosity as reality itself

the master speaking plainly between songs
